description: Fuzzes jobs this box already ran: mutates a bounded corpus of retained jobs on idle cycles, runs variants through the runner's confined execution, and files failures, divergence, and new coverage.
name: job_fuzz

signals.description: A variant broke the run itself: the confined execution timed out, or the execution path errored around the run. The detail names the seed job, the mutator, and the archived variant file.
signals.name: variant_hard_failure

signals.description: A variant ran and its outcome class differs from the seed job's recorded class: zero vs nonzero exit, ran vs refused, finished vs timed out. The detail names the mutator and both classes.
signals.name: variant_divergence

signals.description: The first time a (mutator, stage, outcome class) combination is observed: the campaign reached a region it had not reached before. Filed once per combination; the triage memory is bounded.
signals.name: coverage_novelty
